title: Fix TypeScript errors in SCIM and RLS helper functions
body:
TypeScript compilation errors in `src/auth/scim.zod.ts` and `src/permission/rls.zod.ts` blocking CI builds.

## Changes

**RLS Helpers**: Added explicit `priority: 0` to factory functions
- Zod `.default(0)` doesn't make the field optional in `z.infer<>` types
- Affects: `ownerPolicy`, `tenantPolicy`, `rolePolicy`, `allowAllPolicy`

**SCIM Helper**: Type assertion for generic `Resources` field
- Changed `resources` to `resources as Array<SCIMResource | Record<string, any>>`
- Generic `T[]` requires explicit cast to satisfy union type constraint

```typescript
// Before: TS2741 - Property 'priority' is missing
ownerPolicy: (object: string): RowLevelSecurityPolicy => ({
  name: `${object}_owner_access`,
  // ...
  enabled: true,
}),

// After
ownerPolicy: (object: string): RowLevelSecurityPolicy => ({
  name: `${object}_owner_access`,
  // ...
  enabled: true,
  priority: 0,
}),
```
